fields.description: Haircut percentage is the percentage difference between market value of the Loan Security and the value ascribed to that Loan Security when used as collateral for that loan.
fields.label: Haircut %

fields.description: Loan To Value Ratio expresses the ratio of the loan amount to the value of the security pledged. A loan security shortfall will be triggered if this falls below the specified value for any loan
fields.label: Loan To Value Ratio

fields.description: Above this loan-to-value ratio the shortfall goes straight to Sale Triggered, without waiting for the cure period. Leave blank for no early sale
fields.label: Sell LTV

fields.description: Working days a new price from a Loan Security Price Update stays valid, e.g. 1 for shares and 365 for property
fields.label: Price Validity (Working Days)

fields.description: Pledges of this type record the folio, holding and lock-in, and its price updates can read the AMFI NAV file
fields.label: Is Mutual Fund
